info.title: Signal Hub M0 API Contract
info.description: Contract only, with no runtime in M0. Future service is tailnet-only. Source tokens ingest; owner/read-only tokens query; owner alone may replay or reload. Events are append-only, delivery is at-least-once, configuration is git-managed. Alertmanager adapter is planned for M6.

post.summary: Ingest a single CloudEvent or independent batch members
post.description: Source bearer only; authorize source_prefix and allowed_types per event. Unauthorized type or external signalhub.* is forbidden (403). New events return 202 only after SQLite commit; identical source + id and RFC 8785 canonical content return 200 with original seq and duplicate:true; differing content returns 409 without changing the original. data is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes after RFC 8785 serialization. Batch must be a JSON array of 1–100 members; member validation is deliberately not applied to the outer request schema. After envelope/authentication validation batch always returns 200 with results in request order, including member failures. Outer malformed JSON/envelope or auth errors return 4xx; individual invalid_event/forbidden/event_conflict/payload_too_large/unavailable failures belong in results. Each successful member has committed before its result is returned. Content-Type must select a supported media type. Entire HTTP request body is limited to 4 MiB, including whitespace and envelope attributes; oversized bodies return 413 payload_too_large. JSON nesting beyond 64 levels returns 400 invalid_json.

schema.description: Validate CloudEvents separately, preserving independent member outcomes.

200.description: Single identical duplicate, or per-member results for a valid batch envelope.

400.description: Invalid JSON, event/batch envelope, query, reason, or configuration as described by the operation.

409.description: Event content conflicts with an existing source + id (event_conflict), or delivery is not in DLQ (not_replayable).

413.description: Request body exceeds 4 MiB or event data exceeds 16 KiB JCS UTF-8 bytes (payload_too_large).

503.description: Database or other required local resource is unavailable (unavailable); retry later.

get.description: Append-only hot events ordered by event.time descending then seq descending. Type permits a single terminal * wildcard; source is exact. q matches only type, subject and summary, not data. Filters combine with AND. Omitted time bounds query retained hot data. Cursor preserves this sort and the filter set.

get.description: Fetch a hot event and its correlation/causation chain. A purged event returns not_found; this API does not import archives.

400.description: Invalid JSON, event/batch envelope, query, reason, or configuration as described by the operation.

404.description: Resource does not exist in the hot database or active configuration (not_found).

post.description: Local mapping is part of M1; real producer integration is M6. Source bearer is scoped to urn:signalhub:alertmanager:<receiver> and allowed alertmanager.alert.* types. Each alerts array member maps to a CloudEvent per SDD 01; firing uses startsAt, resolved uses endsAt, and stable id is fingerprint:startsAt:status. Results use the zero-based alerts array index and independent ingest semantics. Duplicate notifications retain the original seq. Invalid webhook envelope returns 400; authorization failure returns 401/403. Entire HTTP request body is limited to 4 MiB, including whitespace and envelope attributes; oversized bodies return 413 payload_too_large. JSON nesting beyond 64 levels returns 400 invalid_json.

200.description: One independent ingest result for each alert; committed successes only.

400.description: Invalid JSON, event/batch envelope, query, reason, or configuration as described by the operation.

get.description: Retained rollup time series, including version boundaries and partial buckets. group is an exact serialized group_key. Results ordered by bucket_start ascending, rule_version ascending, then group_key ascending. cursor/limit follow the common list contract. recomputable_from is the earliest currently hot event time, or null without hot events.

post.summary: Replay a DLQ delivery with an audit reason
post.description: Owner only. Only DLQ deliveries may be replayed. Commit transition to pending and audit reason before returning 202. Retain the original stable delivery_id. Nonblank reason required; malformed JSON returns invalid_json and missing/blank reason returns invalid_reason.

202.description: Replay scheduled after persistent transition and audit write.

400.description: Invalid JSON, event/batch envelope, query, reason, or configuration as described by the operation.

404.description: Resource does not exist in the hot database or active configuration (not_found).

409.description: Event content conflicts with an existing source + id (event_conflict), or delivery is not in DLQ (not_replayable).

503.description: Database or other required local resource is unavailable (unavailable); retry later.

post.description: Owner only. No request body; reread the configured sources/rules/subscriptions files and validate the complete configuration. Reject invalid configuration with invalid_config (400), keep the old effective configuration, and emit signalhub.config.rejected. Success emits signalhub.config.reloaded and writes audit_log. This does not edit configuration or expose metadata endpoints.

200.description: All configuration validated and atomically activated.

400.description: Invalid JSON, event/batch envelope, query, reason, or configuration as described by the operation.

503.description: Database or other required local resource is unavailable (unavailable); retry later.

200.description: Required local configuration and database are ready.

503.description: Not ready; tailnet probe discloses no internal error detail.

get.description: Read-only self-observation: process-lifetime ingest/error counters, duplicate/conflict counters, subscription pending/inflight/DLQ counts, rule last successful computation, last archive result, database size and free disk bytes. Null timestamps/results mean no observation yet.

400.description: Invalid JSON, event/batch envelope, query, reason, or configuration as described by the operation.

503.description: Database or other required local resource is unavailable (unavailable); retry later.

EventDetail.description: Related events share correlationid or are directly referenced by causationid. Excludes item; deduplicated by seq and ordered by event.time then seq ascending. A missing/archived causation target is omitted.

Rollup.description: group_key is the stable serialized grouping key; null value means no aggregate value (for example an empty avg bucket), not zero.

SourceFreshness.description: A runtime view, not a sources configuration wrapper. Times are null before the first event; expected_interval null disables freshness checks. For a seen source with checks disabled, status is fresh. Thresholds use last_received_at: late > interval, silent > 2 × interval.

DeliveryAttempt.description: error is a short failure summary; response body and credentials are never included. http_status is null for transport failures.

Delivery.description: For immediate delivery event_seq is set and window_start null; for digest event_seq is null and window_start set. delivery_id stays unchanged through retries and replay.

ReplayRequest.description: A nonblank reason is required and recorded in audit_log.

IngestCounters.description: Counters since process start. total counts per-event ingest attempts; accepted excludes duplicates. Batch members each count once; malformed request envelopes count in errors but have no event attempt.

AlertmanagerV4.description: M1 local Alertmanager webhook v4 mapping; up to 100 alerts, including an empty heartbeat. Real producer integration is M6.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor issued for the same endpoint and filters. Invalid or mismatched cursors return invalid_query.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum items on a page; defaults to 100.

from.name: from
from.description: Inclusive lower bound on event time (or bucket_start for metrics). Omission leaves this bound open.

to.name: to
to.description: Exclusive upper bound on event time (or bucket_start for metrics). If both bounds are present, from must be earlier than to.

sourceBearer.description: Registered producer token; restricts source_prefix and allowed_types, denies signalhub.*; no query/replay/reload rights.

ownerBearer.description: Owner token for query, replay and configuration reload.

readOnlyBearer.description: Read-only query token for an AI agent or decision system; no ingest/replay/reload.
